title: Shift/Indent (>>, <<)
instruction_text:
Indent and unindent lines!

'>>' = indent current line (shift right)
'<<' = unindent current line (shift left)
'3>>' = indent 3 lines
In visual mode: '>' indents, '<' unindents

Your task: Fix the indentation of this code.

Steps:
1. Move to 'echo "inside"' (line 2)
2. Press '>>' to indent it
3. Move to line 3 ('done')
4. Press '>>' to indent it... wait, 'done' should NOT be indented!
5. Press '<<' to unindent it back
6. Save with :wq

Alternative: Use '2>>' on line 2 to indent 2 lines at once.
